title: The Mall World is a Central Meeting Point of Human Souls when Dreaming. Also ATM Machines are Portals.. Read my bizarre dream for more details
content: Had a bizarre dream the other night I just had to share here. In the dream, I am within the Mall World. I am at the bottom/ground floor. The mall has white walls this time rather than neon lights (which I often see) but still looks kind of rundown. (I never get the fancy mall dreams, mine always remind me of malls that have way past their prime.) I am being harassed/hunted down by a man with very light blonde hair, blue eyes, and elvish sort of face. It's a figure who has tried to mess with me in other dreams. (Will share if people are interested, not exactly Mall Dream related.) When he is filled with rage his eyes turn red/orange. He has police officers at his disposal who are there as backup. He grabs my arm and twists it violently, when suddenly, a male figure rescues me away from him and takes me to an ATM machine which transports us to a different location. We are transported to some kind of drug store, like a CVS or Walgreens if that helps describe the scene. It's nighttime outside the store. The nice man explains that ATM machines can be used as portals when dreaming but we have to be careful, as they are heavily monitored and used to easily track dreamers, so they should be used in a pinch rather than as a rule. He explains that the Mall World is a central area in the dream landscape where most humans congregate, and thus it makes it easy to find who "they" are looking for there. He further explains that the drug store we are currently in is not as central of a location, but still common enough that it can only be a temporary respite as they will be coming for us. Sure enough, armed officers wearing Riot Gear come through the drug store. Don (name of nice man) explains that I need to freeze and not react, as when dreamers are not lucid, they freeze in situations like this so the Officers know they are not awake. I do my best to freeze as they Officers search the area. In a quick instant, Don and I find another ATM machine to act as a portal and then I wake up. ***Thoughts*** - So I do not claim to have any answers but I can't help but wonder what if this is all true about the dream world?? Has anyone tried using an ATM as a portal? Or any other kind of portal? - It does make sense to me that these recurring locations (Mall World, School World, Bathroom World, Train station, Carnival, etc.) are common entry points for dreamers and if you are for some reason being tracked by a hostile Lucifer type like myself, it makes it easy to find you. - In general, I have found that the dream world does not take kindly to those who are lucid. Many times when I've reached lucidity I am tracked and hunted down, sometimes by MIB type figures, sometimes by evil Blondie, or in general dream characters turning demonic. - I've also had dreams where characters react with kindness and try to help me out like the man above. Once a dream character told me "dreaming is closer to the real world than when we are awake."
